{{Disambig|Undead}}

==Enemies==
'''Undead''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Frost Undead]], a fast, high health enemy that first appears on Wave 23 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Frost Undead/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Undead Miner]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 20 in [[Badlands II]]
**[[Undead Miner/Advanced Stats]]
'''Undead''' may also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Korblox Undead (The Classic)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 2 in [[Classic Winter|The Classic Mission 2]], Wave 2 in [[Classic Island Chaos|The Classic Mission 4]], and Wave 3 in [[Classic Castle|The Classic Mission 5]]
*[[Korblox Undead (The Hunt)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 2 in [[Huevous Hunt]]
**[[Korblox Undead (The Hunt)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Korblox Undead (The Hunt: Mega Edition)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 2 in [[Korblox Temple]]
**[[Korblox Undead (The Hunt: Mega Edition)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Undead (Solar Eclipse)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 1 in [[Rotfield|Night I]] of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]
*[[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 1 in [[Trick or Threat Town]]
